conclusion: The October 17 Orca upstream integration and large-project compatibility/performance observations remain historical at their original source and input anchors. In the 2026-10-25 audit, twelve of fourteen bindings from the October 22 support-scope record are unchanged; SupportCommon.cpp and TreeSupport.cpp have advanced. Current support correctness is covered by the separately source-bound Release/test2 verification, not by extrapolating the historical large-project timing or exact-output identities. This refresh does not establish a new upstream merge, remote-ref state, GUI/macOS runtime result or current large-project benchmark.
scope: Historical upstream integration versus current support verification as of 2026-10-25; No new upstream fetch, remote HEAD audit, macOS/GUI runtime test or large-project timing benchmark was performed.
